name: Wildlife
title: The Untamed Kingdom
description: The behavior, survival and hidden lives of Earth's species.
longDescription: From the deepest oceanic trenches to the canopy of cloud forests, witness the extraordinary adaptations and untold behaviors of the creatures sharing our living planet.

name: Planet
title: Forces Shaping Earth
description: Oceans, climate, geology and the systems shaping Earth.
longDescription: Explore volcanic calderas, glacial tongues, atmospheric rivers, and the delicate planetary equilibria that sustain dynamic life across terrestrial biomes.

name: Science
title: Frontiers of Knowledge
description: Discoveries that change how we understand reality.
longDescription: Peer into quantum coherence, deep time paleontology, synthetic biology, and the revolutionary instruments redefining the boundaries of human comprehension.

name: Space
title: The Infinite Frontier
description: Planets, stars, galaxies and the search beyond Earth.
longDescription: From stellar nurseries across the Orion arm to the icy plumes of Enceladus, journey across cosmic horizons where light and time intertwine.

name: History
title: Echoes of Antiquity
description: Civilizations, archaeology and stories buried by time.
longDescription: Unearth lost temple complexes, decipher forgotten trade routes, and rediscover the masterworks of ancient cultures buried beneath sands and jungle canopies.

name: Culture
title: Human Tapestry
description: People, traditions, identity and changing societies.
longDescription: Immerse in indigenous stewardship, ancestral musical traditions, architectural resilience, and the enduring human spirit in a rapidly globalizing era.

name: Exploration
title: Beyond the Frontier
description: Remote places and journeys beyond the familiar.
longDescription: Join expeditions traversing uncharted subterranean karst systems, polar ice sheets, and high alpine ridges where maps yield to discovery.

name: Photography
title: The Visual Chronicle
longDescription: A celebration of visual narrative, medium-format field work, rare natural phenomena, and the dedicated photographers braving extremes to bring back truth in light.
